title: Extensionality on reduction-unit pure tensors at a single scalar source level
statement: Fix a prime ell, finite Q_ell extensions E and F, an algebra map i:E→F and a scheme W. Use [def-pur-constant-scalar-tensor-data] and [def-pur-native-reduction-counit-data]. For any completed E-module sheaf M, level n and constant B-module sheaf N, two B-module maps from B tensor_A the nth ordinary E-reduction of M to N are equal if, for every site object U, b in B(U) and x in M(U), they agree on b tensor eta_E,n(x). Here eta_E,n is the specified ordinary quotient/limit adjunction unit followed by the nth limit projection. No balancing, ramification, or comparison with F reduction is assumed.

source.place: lemma-adjointness-tensor-restrict (Tag 03EK), section-tensor-product; sites-cohomology.tex section-derived-limits (Tag 0940). Single-level quotient algebra and local generation in the original ordinaryBalancing_existsUnique docstring.

proof.text: Compute the nth evaluation of the ordinary quotient-system left adjoint as sheafified quotient extension of M. Its universal tensor unit agrees with the unit of the specified adjunction, by uniqueness of left adjoints and the diagonal/limit adjunction.

The underlying quotient unit is an epimorphism of sheaves, so locally every quotient section lifts to M. In the scalar extension the tensors b tensor eta(x) generate locally: express a section locally as a finite sum of pure tensors and refine the cover to lift all second factors. Agreement on the prescribed sections gives agreement on these sums by additivity and therefore on all sections by separatedness.
Apply module-sheaf extensionality to conclude equality of the two maps. The argument is independent of ramification and of any target reduction.

proof_origin.place: Expansion of the ordinary balancing docstring using the tensor/restriction adjunction and quotient algebra; scalar-source local generation is separate from the ramified single-level comparison.

theorem ordinaryScalarReduction_hom_ext (W : Scheme.{u})
    (M : scalarReductionSource l E W) (n : ℕ)
    (N : Modules (ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l F)) W)
    (f g : (pbcExtend (constantMap l E F i W)).obj
      (((ordinaryReduction l E W ⋙ systemRestriction l E W).obj M).obj (op n)) ⟶ N)
    (h : ∀ (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ) (b : ((constants l F).ring W).obj.obj U)
      (x : M.val.obj U),
      f.val.app U (pbcTensorSection (constantMap l E F i W)
        (((ordinaryReduction l E W ⋙ systemRestriction l E W).obj M).obj (op n)) U b
        ((((ordinaryReductionAdj l E W).unit.app M ≫
          limit.π ((coefficientSequenceRestriction.{u, u} l E W).obj
            ((ordinaryReduction l E W).obj M)) (op n)).val.app U) x)) =
      g.val.app U (pbcTensorSection (constantMap l E F i W)
        (((ordinaryReduction l E W ⋙ systemRestriction l E W).obj M).obj (op n)) U b
        ((((ordinaryReductionAdj l E W).unit.app M ≫
          limit.π ((coefficientSequenceRestriction.{u, u} l E W).obj
            ((ordinaryReduction l E W).obj M)) (op n)).val.app U) x))) : f = g
